cmsSections.title: What is Shilajit?
cmsSections.content: Shilajit is a dark, tar-like mineral resin traditionally gathered from high-altitude Himalayan rock crevices, where plant matter and geological minerals undergo slow natural transformation over centuries. In classical Indian traditions, it is valued as a concentrated mineral-organic substance prepared for mindful daily use.

cmsSections.title: Product Ingredients
cmsSections.content: 100% Shilajit Resin (Asphaltum punjabianum) presented in a 20 g semi-solid resin format with no added synthetic colors, artificial flavors, gums, or fillers.

cmsSections.title: Origin and Sourcing
cmsSections.content: Sourced from Himalayan mineral-bearing regions and processed in small batches with water-based purification and controlled low-temperature concentration. Every jar carries a batch code linked to the Quality & Transparency registry.

cmsSections.title: How to Use
cmsSections.content: Scoop a pea-sized amount (approx. 250–300 mg) with the provided brass spoon. Dissolve completely in 150–200 ml of lukewarm water, warm milk, or herbal tea. Stir until the liquid turns a rich amber-brown and consume calmly as part of your morning or evening routine.

cmsSections.title: Storage and Handling
cmsSections.content: Always close the inner protective disc and outer gold cap tightly after use. Keep at room temperature in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Natural resin stiffens slightly in winter and becomes more pliable in warmer weather; warming the closed jar briefly in your palms restores smooth scooping.

cmsSections.title: Precautions
cmsSections.content: Intended for adult use only. Not recommended for pregnant or nursing women, children, or individuals with elevated uric acid, gout, hemochromatosis, or known kidney conditions without medical guidance. This traditional wellness product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

cmsSections.title: Batch Testing
cmsSections.content: Each production batch is logged in our Quality & Transparency center alongside heavy metal screening parameters, microbiological limits, and view-only laboratory reference records maintained by the store administrator.

cmsSections.title: Why does the resin texture change between summer and winter?
cmsSections.content: Genuine mineral resin responds naturally to ambient temperature—becoming firmer when cool and softer in warmer weather. Warming the closed jar briefly in your palms restores smooth scooping.

cmsSections.title: Does HimRudra Shilajit dissolve completely in warm water?
cmsSections.content: Yes. A pea-sized portion dissolves smoothly in lukewarm water, warm milk, or herbal tea into a rich amber-brown infusion without leaving gritty sand residue.

cmsSections.title: How long does one 20 g jar of HimRudra Shilajit last?
cmsSections.content: At the recommended serving of 250–300 mg (one pea-sized scoop daily), a single 20 g apothecary jar lasts approximately 65 to 75 days.

cmsSections.title: Is HimRudra Shilajit lab certified and can I download the report?
cmsSections.content: Yes. Every production batch is laboratory screened for Fulvic Acid assay, heavy metals, and microbiological safety. Click "Lab Certified" in the top navigation bar anytime to preview or download the official batch certificate.
